statement: No remaining demonstrated product or source blocker within the tested scope.
reviewMethod: Read-only source diff, import-map identity, qualification artifact and runner inspection; no independent full-scene rerun.
sourceFindings: Upper support is sampled from emitted ERODED_TERRAIN and MOUNTAIN_OVERBURDEN triangles, not fabricated analytic support.
Selected layer persists through navigation and evaluation; portal admission checks actual accepted source height.
Interior side/back escape remains fail-closed; explicit invalid layers and inconsistent interior heights are rejected.
Protected geometry and world rendering are unchanged by the support-query correction.
limitations: All four jamb seeds were ineligible; accepted near-jamb transitions were not exercised.
Desktop software WebGL evidence does not establish physical-device performance or perceptual acceptance.
The dark cave screenshot does not establish visual quality.
Bridge calls omitting layer intentionally default to SURFACE; legacy navigation states are supported, but legacy bridge semantics are not identical.
The review is not exhaustive collision or performance certification and does not establish merge or publication completion.
